svg.title: CDN Link Studio — single-file SVG
svg.desc: Full CDN Link Studio app embedded as a single self-contained SVG. Open or host this file in any modern browser and the complete app boots inside a full-page frame: generation, validation, Filter Checker, BYOD hosts, exports, Gofile offload. Settings persist via localStorage.
